promotion: No runtime activation from this offline study; failure preserves default LinUCB. No retuning on evaluation seeds.
cold_stress: Deterministic synthetic initial low needs plus daytime workload increments and a needs shock/stronger workload from shiftDay. Shared by all variants. Not a production metabolism or medical model.
limitations: One-step opportunity cost on each policy own state, not counterfactual long-term regret.
Expected outcome formula is deterministic; residual may only learn state drift and offer no advantage over the model-prior ablation.
Emergency priorities must override voluntary action caps.
Warm prior counts never become earned trials/domain skills or posterior samples.
